title: What is Spring Batch?
content: Spring Batch is used for processing large amounts of data.

title: What is Redis?
content: Redis is an in-memory data store used for caching.

title: What is RabbitMQ?
content: RabbitMQ is a message broker used for asynchronous communication.

title: What is Elasticsearch?
content: Elasticsearch is used for fast searching and indexing of data.

title: What is Spring Security?
content: Spring Security handles authentication and authorization.
